findings.claim: _check_protected_baseline validates only currently supplied recipe profile. It never requires acceptance_config.recipeRefs to equal baseline recipe profiles, nor requires baseline profiles to cover every recipe in recipeRefs.

boundedControl.result: empty issues proves reduced one-profile baseline passes selected-recipe projection check while ten recipeRefs remain

findings.requiredFix: Require exact set equality between recipeRefs & baseline recipes, then require every trusted recipe expansion/profile before tuple10 denominator acceptance.

findings.claim: closure_check accepts closure & measurements artifacts without validating kind/version, provenance, or receipt schema. It checks selected fields only, so closure identity is weaker than raw status/staging bindings.
findings.requiredFix: Validate closure & measurement artifact schemas/kind/version plus exact producer/provenance before postclosure binding.
